description: This file contains functions and imports related to shape inference in PyTorch's FX graph module, including the main infer_shape function that modifies a graph module to annotate shapes, and a helper function mksym for creating symbolic shape nodes.

classes.name: ShapeEnv
classes.description: Class representing the symbolic shape environment used for shape inference.

classes.name: FakeTensorMode
classes.description: Class representing a mode for fake tensor operations in shape inference.

methods.name: infer_shape
methods.description: Main function that performs shape inference on a graph module, modifying it to annotate tensor shapes.

methods.name: mksym
methods.description: Helper function to create a symbolic shape node within the shape environment.
